demand.band: the 10th and 90th percentile of the chosen method's own out-of-sample errors (the log of actual over forecast) at the same local hour, over the 365 days of target days held when the forecast is made

peak.what: the day's highest hourly demand and its local hour; a method's peak is the highest of its own hourly forecasts for the day, and the hour of it

price.held: paused: MISO's terms forbid automated access (warehouse/metadata/paused_sources.csv); no price since 4 October 2026
